chronology.baseline_update_rule: After a complete session closes, add its validated same-clock cumulative-volume prefixes to later sessions' history. Never use the current session or a future session in its own baseline. Keep exactly the ten most recent strictly preceding complete sessions.
chronology.context_only_session_rule: Context-only sessions before each evaluation range may enter the rolling ten-prior-complete-session baseline after their full validated close. They remain signal-ineligible and flat and do not enter P&L, fees, benchmarks, activity, or gates.
chronology.discovery_cold_start_rule: The discovery range begins with no earlier permitted data. Its first ten complete sessions are lookback-ineligible, remain flat, and still update later baselines. Do not acquire earlier data or shorten the lookback.
chronology.early_close_rule: Evaluate maximum-delay hold capacity before the signal. For a candidate horizon h, require bar index h+26. Early closes that lack it remain flat for every scenario so Normal, zero-cost, stress, and delay signal traces stay identical.
chronology.inference_limit: The five exposed periods support bounded hypothesis triage only. They do not establish statistical qualification, future profitability, controlled evaluation, or PAPER readiness.
chronology.ordinary_session_rule: Every complete validated XNYS regular session in the evaluation range is considered in order. A session with fewer than ten prior complete validated sessions is lookback-ineligible. A session lacking enough bars for the candidate horizon, fixed 24-bar hold, and maximum three-bar delay is hold-capacity-ineligible. Both remain flat and in the ledger. Any missing, duplicate, nonconsecutive, misaligned, or negative-volume bar in a required current or baseline prefix is a terminal data failure.
chronology.source: Campaign-owned ordinary-session chronology. Exact period boundaries and exposed data identities match the bound base artifacts. Context-only sessions supply causal prior-session cumulative-volume history and never enter evaluation P&L or gates.

controlled_evaluation.empty_cohort_action: Close as immutable exposed evidence and advance only under the Campaign 3 transition rule.
controlled_evaluation.nonempty_cohort_action: Freeze the exposed survivor and wait for future untouched data. No controlled evaluation or qualification is authorized.

data.run_dataset_input_rule: Sort bindings by allowed_read_start. Include each binding that intersects context_start through evaluation_end. Each entry has exactly dataset_id, fingerprint, raw_fingerprint, read_start=max(context_start, allowed_read_start), read_end=min(evaluation_end, allowed_read_end), evaluation_read_start=max(evaluation_start, allowed_read_start), and evaluation_read_end=min(evaluation_end, allowed_read_end). Set both evaluation fields to null when the binding does not intersect the evaluation range.

execution.paired_normal_zero_cost_decision_trace: For every candidate-period Normal and zero_cost_diagnostic pair, including immediate-neighbor runs, require equal execution_evidence.decision_trace_fingerprint values. A mismatch is a terminal deterministic failure.

bound_base_artifacts: execution cost model and session safeguards
inheritance.interpretation: The base artifacts are byte-bound dependencies for data identity, execution safeguards, and protected disposition. Campaign 2 owns its ordinary-session chronology, prior-session relative-volume feature, joint strategy, candidate graph, screens, runtime, and reports. The base event calendar, event mechanics, candidates, screens, and results are not inherited.

program_state_source.successor_state_rule: Never mutate revision 3. After this exact plan passes independent review, publish immutable revision 4 binding revision 3, this plan, and its review before implementation.

purpose: Test whether joint positive early SPY/QQQ returns with unusually high same-clock cumulative volume predict broad drift over one fixed multi-hour hold on ordinary XNYS sessions.

report_contract.active_session: A signal-eligible session with exactly one synchronized SPY round trip and one synchronized QQQ round trip, matching signal and decision traces across paired scenarios, and the frozen decisions.

aggregate_definitions.aggregate_concentrations: Recompute symbol, session, period, and participation-bucket positive concentration from the concatenated ledger; never average fold concentrations.
aggregate_definitions.aggregate_profit_and_cost: Sum fold gross P&L, execution friction, and net P&L, then recheck the accounting equation.
aggregate_definitions.aggregate_signal_trace_mismatch_count: Sum per-period signal_trace_mismatch_count across every required Normal/zero-cost pair; any missing pair is terminal and the required aggregate is zero.
aggregate_definitions.aggregate_total_return: Sum fold total returns under the inherited Exposed 002 aggregation convention.
aggregate_definitions.fold_combination: Concatenate session ledgers in frozen period order; periods and session dates must be disjoint.
aggregate_definitions.joint_positive_neighbor_fraction: Count immediate neighbors with strictly positive aggregate Normal and zero-cost total return and net P&L divided by the exact neighbor count; no rounding.
aggregate_definitions.median_neighbor_normal_profit_retention: Median of each neighbor aggregate Normal net P&L divided by the positive base aggregate Normal net P&L.
aggregate_definitions.minimum_active_sessions_in_positive_norm: Minimum Normal active_session_count among positive Normal folds; undefined if none are positive.
aggregate_definitions.neighbor_signal_trace_mismatch_count: Sum signal_trace_mismatch_count over every required neighbor period pair after identity deduplication; any missing pair is terminal and the required value is zero.
aggregate_definitions.positive_fold: A fold whose net P&L and total return in the named scenario are both strictly positive.
aggregate_definitions.stress_profit_retention: Scenario aggregate net P&L divided by base Normal aggregate net P&L; undefined unless the base is positive.

benchmark_references.authority: Report-only references; never selection gates or authority.
benchmark_references.fixed_50_50_continuous: Arithmetic mean of SPY and QQQ continuous returns.
benchmark_references.qqq_continuous: QQQ last evaluation close / QQQ first evaluation open - 1, before costs.
benchmark_references.scope: Evaluation bars only; context bars are excluded.
benchmark_references.spy_continuous: SPY last evaluation close / SPY first evaluation open - 1, before costs.

report_contract.canonical_metric_decode_rule: After canonical JSON reload, required numeric screening values must be JSON integers, null only where the metric is semantically undefined, or canonical finite Decimal strings. Reject booleans, floats, whitespace, exponent notation, noncanonical strings, non-finite values, missing keys, and silent omission. Convert valid strings to Decimal before every discovery, walk-forward, stress, neighbor, and ranking operation.
report_contract.dataset_inputs: Ordered exact entries derived from the campaign-owned data binding and period intersection; each has dataset_id, fingerprint, raw_fingerprint, read_start, read_end, evaluation_read_start, and evaluation_read_end.
report_contract.participation_bucket_profit_concentratio: Maximum strictly positive participation-bucket net P&L divided by the sum of strictly positive bucket net P&L; undefined when no bucket is positive. Buckets are fixed before results.
report_contract.period_profit_concentration: Maximum strictly positive period aggregate net P&L divided by the sum of strictly positive period aggregate net P&L; undefined when no period is positive.
report_contract.session_ledger_row: Record every evaluated session date, disposition, signal-eligible and capacity flags, horizon, ordered baseline session dates, per-symbol prior cumulative-prefix values and medians, current cumulative volumes, relative-volume ratios, returns, return and relative-volume predicate flags, joint relative volume, nullable participation strength and bucket, active flag, synchronized entry/exit decision and fill timestamps, per-symbol fill counts and round trips, gross P&L, adverse slippage, regulatory fees, execution friction, and net P&L. Ineligible sessions retain a reason and zero P&L; context-only sessions are excluded.
report_contract.session_observation_unit: One ordinary XNYS session. The synchronized SPY and QQQ positions are one correlated participation observation, while completed_round_trips still counts both symbol round trips.
report_contract.session_profit_concentration: Maximum strictly positive session net P&L divided by the sum of strictly positive session net P&L; undefined when no session is positive.
report_contract.session_reconciliation_rule: Every evaluated session has exactly one disposition. Active sessions alone may have two fills and one completed round trip per symbol. Inactive and ineligible sessions have zero orders, fills, fees, friction, and P&L. Aggregate counts and P&L equal exact ledger sums.
report_contract.signal_trace_fingerprint: Fingerprint the cost-independent signal trace defined by the strategy contract. Normal, zero-cost, stress, delay, and reused immediate-neighbor evidence for the same candidate-period must match exactly.
report_contract.symbol_profit_concentration: Maximum strictly positive symbol net P&L divided by the sum of strictly positive symbol net P&L; undefined when neither symbol is positive.
report_contract.terminal_semantic_validation_rule: Before terminal interpretation, recompute every reached-stage gate from the exact canonical reports, compare the stored screening ledgers, verify report-to-ledger identity and cohort derivation, and fail closed on any mismatch. Hash-valid but semantically incomplete screening evidence is not terminally acceptable.

research_basis.campaign_1_non_adaptation: Campaign 2 was predeclared before Campaign 1 ran. Campaign 1 reports, returns, gate margins, and candidate activity did not select or alter this plan's horizons, volume floors, lookback, return floor, estimator, hold, gates, or budget.

complete_exposed_evidence.disposition: The one-bar momentum and 12-bar moving-average contracts failed all 12 research qualification groups; repeated exact-weight scheduling and friction dominated the recorded V2 implementation.
A 325-parent price, volatility, volume-filtered breakout, VWAP, relative-strength, and combination search ended empty; most apparent gross edge did not survive costs or chronology.

The campaign completed four of 120 discovery rows, then closed terminally interrupted under its frozen no-retry rule. Its partial rows remain exposed evidence but cannot support merit inference, adaptation, resumption, or a qualification outcome.
A sparse 60-parent program found one serious trend-pullback candidate, but it failed the exact immediate-neighbor gate and cannot be rescued, rounded, or retuned.
Joint long-only drift after scheduled pre-open BLS releases activated too rarely and too concentratively; friction did not cause the rejection.
BLS-session signed QQQ-minus-SPY leader continuation failed at all nine parent points; the result must not be inverted into a rescue campaign.
Scheduled-event SPY opening-range continuation had positive low-buffer points but insufficient gross edge, activity, or event diversification.
Scheduled-event SPY prior-low rejection completed six runs once and froze empty after all three candidates failed discovery.

research_basis.new_hypothesis: When both SPY and QQQ have returned at least 15 basis points and both have unusually high cumulative volume versus the same clock interval in the prior ten complete sessions, broad participation may continue over the next fixed 24 bars.
research_basis.novelty_boundary: This is a cross-session same-clock participation state. It is not an opening-range breakout, current-bar versus recent-bar volume filter, cumulative VWAP rule, trend-pullback recovery, event strategy, relative rank, or reuse of the prior volume-filter parameters.
prohibited_inferences: Do not use any Campaign 1 result to change this mechanism, axes, fixed terms, gates, or budget.
Do not use opening_bars 1/2/3/6, volume_window 6/12, volume_ratio 1/1.25, or exit_bar 48 from the prior volume-filtered breakout contract.
Do not add a price breakout, opening-range level, VWAP, recent-bar volume comparison, pullback, short arm, rank, event filter, or reentry.
Do not expand either parameter axis, alter the ten-session median, 15-basis-point joint return floor, joint half weights, 24-bar hold, or neighbor graph after any result.
Do not access June 2026, Intraday V3, daily 2018-2019, protected results, PAPER or broker state, strategic-allocation-21, or live data.
supported_observations: The predeclared autonomous program identifies same-clock participation drift as a distinct unanswered mechanism after broad volume-filtered breakout and VWAP searches closed empty.

Current cumulative volume is compared only with the same completed clock interval in prior complete sessions; no opening-range high, recent-bar volume comparison, VWAP, or price breakout enters the signal.
One joint state-changing entry and a fixed 24-bar hold make the mechanism slower and sparser than the rejected high-turnover volume-filtered rules.
The exposed domain supports bounded rejection only; no result can establish controlled qualification, future profitability, or trading authority.

runtime.implementation_gate: Merge this exact plan, its finding-free independent review, and immutable revision 4. Then implement the strict loader, causal same-clock strategy, session report, semantic screen validation, 90-spec runner, CLI, and tests on a separate branch. Bind exact merged implementation main and a finding-free launch-control review before the first reservation.

search_budget.budget_invariant: The runner reserves only frozen candidate-period-scenario identities, deduplicates later-stage evidence, rejects any Campaign 2 reservation above 90, and treats the three-attempt ceiling as recovery rather than search expansion. Campaign 1 unused capacity never transfers.

immediate_neighbor_maximum.formula: at most 4 immediate neighbors * 4 periods * 2 scenarios

search_budget.unit: One immutable run specification contains one candidate, period, and cost or delay scenario.

serious_candidate_screen.cross_scenario_signal_trace_rule: Every scenario for one candidate-period must have the same signal_trace_fingerprint, and every Normal/zero-cost pair must also have the same decision trace. A mismatch is terminal before screening.
serious_candidate_screen.neighbor_topology: The exact all-neighbor gate requires corners to pass 2/2, edges 3/3, and the center 4/4. Do not round a lower fraction upward.

stage_rules.empty_cohort_action: Close as immutable negative exposed evidence and advance only to Campaign 3 under the frozen autonomous program.
stage_rules.final_cohort_rule: Freeze the one serious candidate only if it passes every stress and applicable immediate-neighbor gate simultaneously. Do not rank, substitute, or discard an all-gate survivor.
stage_rules.nonempty_cohort_action: Freeze the survivor and stop the autonomous program while waiting for future untouched data; do not create a controlled plan for exposed bars.
stage_rules.run_identity_and_deduplication_rule: Canonical run identity is candidate_id, period_id, scenario_id. Reserve each identity at most once. Neighbor evaluation reuses completed identical walk-forward Normal or zero-cost rows and reserves only missing identities; unused budget remains unused.

strategy_contract.bar_indexing: Zero-based within each validated XNYS regular session.
strategy_contract.economic_hypothesis: Joint positive early SPY/QQQ price action with high cumulative participation versus the same clock in prior complete sessions may continue during a fixed multi-hour hold.
strategy_contract.economic_mechanism: same-clock participation shock and gradual order-flow absorption
strategy_contract.entry_rule: After bar h-1 completes, target SPY and QQQ at weight 0.5 each. Normal delay 1 fills both at bar h open. Entry decisions and fill timestamps must match across symbols.
strategy_contract.exit_rule: After completed bar h+23, target both symbols flat. For delay d in 1, 2, or 3, both entries fill at bar h-1+d open and both exits fill at bar h+23+d open, exactly 24 five-minute intervals after entry. Decision bars never move with delay.
strategy_contract.observation_rule: Require complete timestamp-aligned SPY/QQQ bars 0 through h-1 after the causal ten-session baseline exists and maximum-delay hold capacity passes. Compute each return as 10,000 * (bar[h-1].close / bar[0].open - 1). Activate only when both returns are at least the fixed 15-basis-point floor and both relative-volume ratios are at least the candidate floor. Equality passes each inclusive boundary. Joint relative volume is min(SPY relative volume, QQQ relative volume).
strategy_contract.one_entry_invariant: An active session has one synchronized SPY round trip and one synchronized QQQ round trip, four fills, no resize, and no reentry. Any partial, duplicate, unmatched, or outside-contract outcome is a terminal deterministic failure.
strategy_contract.parameter_rationale: Eight, sixteen, and twenty-four completed bars represent 40, 80, and 120 minutes and avoid the prior volume-filtered contract's 1/2/3/6 opening bars and 6/12 volume windows. Relative-volume floors 1.2, 1.5, and 2 form a sparse moderate/strong/extreme scale and avoid its 1 and 1.25 ratios. A ten-session median is causal, fits every frozen fold context, and resists one unusual prior day. The joint 15-basis-point floor, equal half weights, and 24-bar hold are fixed mechanism terms rather than searched axes.

parameters.indexing_rule: Axis indices are one-based. Expand observation_horizon_bars in listed order as the outer axis and minimum_joint_relative_volume in listed order as the inner axis.
parameters.neighbor_rule: Immediate neighbors differ on exactly one axis by one adjacent listed value and match on the other axis. IDs are sorted and the graph is symmetric.

strategy_contract.participation_strength: For an active session, q = joint relative volume / candidate relative-volume floor. It is defined and at least one.
strategy_contract.same_clock_volume_rule: For symbol s and horizon h, current cumulative volume is the integer sum of nonnegative volume for current bars 0 through h-1. For each of the ten most recent strictly preceding complete validated sessions, compute the same cumulative prefix. Sort those ten values and define the baseline median as the arithmetic mean of values five and six. The baseline median must be strictly positive; a zero current cumulative volume yields relative volume zero and an inactive signal. Relative volume is current cumulative volume divided by the median with Decimal and no rounding. No current-session bar after h-1, current-session completed total, or future session may enter the feature.
strategy_contract.signal_trace_rule: Fingerprint session date, candidate parameters, ordered ten-session baseline dates, each symbol's ten cumulative-prefix values and median, current cumulative volume, relative-volume ratio, completed return, predicate result, participation bucket or inactive reason, entry decision timestamp, and planned exit decision timestamp. Exclude scenario, fills, later prices, costs, fees, and post-entry returns.
